command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77
BR=chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-parallax-benefit-ab-20260912
TD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/parallax-benefit-run-v2.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TD"' EXIT
gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json' 'repos/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity/contents/research_entity/avatar/tools/parallax_blind_benefit_stimulus.py?ref=31b2a5671a236fef8802d18e96c16aad68e29a21' > "$TD/stimulus.py"
echo TOOL_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TD/stimulus.py" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$TD/stimulus.py" --visual-root /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual --chrome /usr/bin/google-chrome --out "$TD/out"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity "$TD/repo" -- --branch "$BR" --single-branch --quiet
DEST="$TD/repo/research_entity/avatar/evidence/PARALLAX_BENEFIT_AB_20260912"
mkdir -p "$DEST"
cp "$TD/out/manifest.json" "$DEST/manifest.json"
cp "$TD/out/metrics.json" "$DEST/metrics.json"
cp "$TD/out/blind_contact_sheet.jpg" "$DEST/blind_contact_sheet.jpg"
cp "$TD/out/blind_phase_zero.png" "$DEST/blind_phase_zero.png"
cd "$TD/repo"
git config user.name 'FranKenstein GPT-5.6 Sol'
git config user.email 'frankenstein-gpt56sol@localhost'
git add research_entity/avatar/evidence/PARALLAX_BENEFIT_AB_20260912
git commit -m 'avatar parallax: persist blind benefit stimulus evidence'
git push -q origin "$BR"
echo EVIDENCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo CONTACT_SHA=$(sha256sum "$DEST/blind_contact_sheet.jpg" | awk '{print $1}')
echo ZERO_SHA=$(sha256sum "$DEST/blind_phase_zero.png" | awk '{print $1}')
echo DONE=1
